svg.title: What the Orleans Levee District reported in 2002 about Vogt and Edgecombe claims
svg.desc: Original Final Vestige Studios analytical graphic. The fiscal 2002 audited statement lists a Vogt and Edgecombe judgment basis of 1,831,528 dollars, 108,683 dollars reported paid in small claims by August 15, 2000, and 1,722,845 dollars of principal still unpaid as of June 30, 2002, plus interest. The three figures reconcile arithmetically within the financial statement but do not explain why the 1998 appellate judgment was 2,853,358 dollars and 44 cents. Reported payments have not been checked against cleared checks or claimant receipts.
